tw-wi-lynn-olesen-maple-box-1900.st: Another printing of the same wire story, the Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune of 10 Nov 1900, p. 2, says Olesen farmed between Lynn and Romadka, the next station west, and that the 1899 roadside skeleton was found near the spot. The farm itself still has to be placed from a plat.
src: Wisconsin Rapids Daily Tribune 10 Nov 1900 p. 2, "Box of Plunder Is Discovered Buried Under Tree Near Lynn" (newspapers.com image 242684800)
